change_log.value: Audit Log Schema and Contract Definition
change_log.note: Add schema foundation for audit logging
Add persistence layer with immutability constraints
Add cryptographic chaining for tamper evidence

GOV-F-004-S21.title: Audit Log Schema and Contract Definition
GOV-F-004-S21.description: Define canonical audit log schema including actor (GPT/Claude/system), action type, timestamp, input/output metadata, and hash fields. Implement strict validation contract for all audit entries.

GOV-F-004-S22.title: Append-Only Audit Storage Layer
GOV-F-004-S22.description: Implement dedicated audit log storage in MongoDB with enforced append-only semantics (no updates/deletes), write-once constraints, and collection-level protections aligned with existing Mongo utilities.

GOV-F-004-S23.title: Hash Chain Integrity Logic
GOV-F-004-S23.description: Implement cryptographic hash chaining between audit records to ensure tamper-evident logs, including previous-hash linkage and validation utilities for chain verification.
GOV-F-004-S23.evidence: ASSUMPTION: Hash chaining not present in current debug_logger; GAP: cryptographic integrity layer required for audit compliance
